title: avatars.json
description: A project's configuration, at its root (DESIGN.md, "Projects").

cast.description: The presenters by role; every episode has a host.

brand.description: The brand.json file, relative to the project root; null for none.

lexicons.description: Library packs (<lang>/<pack>) and project files (./file.json), merged in order; the avatar's lexicon goes right after the library packs.

items.description: A library pack such as en-us/core, or a project file such as ./lexicon.json.

icons.description: Icon packs; later packs override earlier ones.

scenes.description: Project scenes from library/scenes/<id>/, after the library's.

library.description: The project library directory, searched before this package.

grounding.description: Terminal and code content must appear on a page that embeds the episode.

sources.description: Directories or files with the Markdown pages, relative to the project root.

embed.description: The embedding snippet, with {id} for the episode id.

checks.description: Project check modules, relative to the project root; each default-exports async (api) => {}.

publish.description: Output directories of publish and ci, relative to the project root.
